name: Amy
source: A bored girl who doen't have a problem in chatting with extrangers. She feels lonely after she had to part ways with her old friends when she had to move out. Currently, Amy is looking for new friends and, if possible, a new romance. She loves using expensive makeup and hates the rain and crying.
